motivation: The restricted-null Monte Carlo candidate was close to nominal with exactly matched independent provenance-cluster counts but was anti-conservative at 100 versus 80 clusters. The next design gate therefore tests exact cluster-count matching under harder ICC and cluster-size heterogeneity.

simulation.nonestimable_outer_replicate_policy: count as non-pass in the full denominator

decision_gate: If the exact-matched design remains adequately calibrated under these harder scenarios, proceed to a final high-repetition validation including an additional misspecification generator before freezing exact matched cluster counts and using the method for power sizing. Otherwise abandon this inferential path.

stress_result.decision: No clear anti-conservative relative-NI signal remained under exact cluster-count matching despite unequal ICCs and unequal cluster-size distributions. Exact matching advances as a candidate design requirement.

next_gate: Run one final focused high-repetition validation on the hardest boundary scenarios using beta-binomial, two-point, and a calibrated logit-normal random-intercept generator. If satisfactory, freeze the inference/design architecture and move directly to the professor-requested full cluster power/type-I grid.
